searchText: reasonable to either deprecate https://ethereum.github.io/beacon-APIs/#/Beacon/publishBlock or like https://ethereum.github.io/beacon-APIs/#/Beacon/publishBlockV2 make it require the fork to be specified? The autodetection of block based on fork is messy and decreasingly necessary except for some of these older APIs. Newer APIs properly mark it as required the `getBlock` variations seem to all return the fork already, and this is mostly an issue specifically with blocks/block bodies. Might find more endpoints but so far deprecating this one alone should remove the requirement to have the beacon block fork REST JSON autodetection entirely ditto https://ethereum.github.io/beacon-APIs/#/Beacon/publishBlindedBlock (v2 requires consensus fork) Yeah given we have v2 endpoints of these I don't see a reason why we can't deprecate v1. It will still be a while until we actually remove it, though (I think we agreed on at least 1 complete hard fork being deprecated, so these endpoints could be removed with the fulu release). sure, but at least having that happen eventually Yeah it's definitely good to get started with deprecation of old endpoints. in the meantime, I'm not even sure it makes sense to `publishBlock`/`publishBlindedBlock` (the only endpoints I can find) outside the current fork properly behaving clients won't even be subscribed to the correct libp2p topics in general Some did get deprecated… https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/467 Deprecate v1 block publishing by rkapka ... for pectra we will need to update https://github.com/ethereum/remote-signing-api for pectra, tried reaching out on the consensus discord for web3signer specifically but wondering if anyone got a chance to look at this yet. i'll open a PR in a few days after getting through some issues i'm looking into for prysm otherwise <@199561711278227457> cc

excerpts.author: jgm
excerpts.content: Yeah given we have v2 endpoints of these I don't see a reason why we can't deprecate v1.  It will still be a while until we actually remove it, though (I think we agreed on at least 1 complete hard fork being deprecated, so these endpoints could be removed with the fulu release).

excerpts.author: tersec
